topic.readerProblem: Work out what Otterly.AI is, what its features really cover, what it costs and whether it suits their team, without paying for a trial first.
topic.connection: Helps readers choose between a recurring AI-search tracker and a one-time AI visibility audit, the buying decision AEOeye's audit sits in front of.

assessment: The page is documentation-based and says so near the top: it rests on Otterly's own features, pricing and help-center pages checked on 2026-10-03, with no hands-on testing and no claim about accuracy. It replaces an older page that described Otterly as a small-business tool and gave no verifiable prices, adds the real feature list, the data-collection method and its limits, plan prices with a link to the detailed pricing guide, fit criteria and honest pros and cons. It deliberately does not repeat the vendor's ratings, customer quotes or user counts as fact, and it flags where Otterly's own pages disagree (trial length, user counts, country counts).

sources.supports: Lite $29 / Standard $189 / Premium $489 monthly (annual $25 / $160 / $422 per month) with 15 / 100 / 400 prompts, the four base engines, add-on prices for Google AI Mode, Gemini and Claude by tier, plan target labels, 3 recommendations per week on Lite, API/MCP/Looker Studio from Standard, Enterprise custom from 1,000 prompts.
Seven tracked engines, feature list (prompt research, sentiment, citations, ads tracking, workspaces, exports, Looker Studio, MCP, API), '65+ countries'.
Prompts from keyword, brand or URL, intent and funnel tagging, Query Fan-Out view, Estimated Intent Score because OpenAI does not disclose prompt volume.
Brand mentions, share of voice, average rank, sentiment, website citation tracking, Gap Analyzer, reporting exports, Looker Studio connector.
GEO Audit testing 19 AI crawlers, Content Audit with 15 structural checks and 13 AI readiness dimensions, ranked recommendations, crawlability check using named user agents.
Engines read through public web interfaces, Otterly's stated reasons for not using APIs, API used only for Claude, results differ from personal sessions, each prompt assigned to a country.
Prompts run daily, no manual run, frequency cannot be changed, Otterly's statement that AI responses are not deterministic and daily checks build sample size.
7-day free trial, no credit card required (article dated August 4, 2026).
Access continues to end of billing cycle; tracked engines and historical data are deleted after cancellation.
Otterly's announcement of the 2025 Gartner Cool Vendors for AI in Marketing recognition, 'Austria-based company', and Gartner's disclaimer that it does not endorse vendors.
Definition of generative engine optimization as improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
GEO paper (Aggarwal et al.): optimization methods can boost visibility by up to 40% in generative engine responses; effectiveness varies by domain.
Accuracy varied by up to 15% across runs of LLMs configured to be deterministic (Atil et al.).
Google says AI Mode and AI Overviews may use different models and techniques, so responses and links differ.

checks: Writer (Sonnet): fetched otterly.ai, /pricing, /features and its prompt-research, analytics and optimization pages with curl (browser user agent) on 2026-10-03, converted them to raw text and compared every price, plan label, add-on price and feature claim in the page against that text.

Writer (Sonnet): fetched the Otterly help-center articles on data collection, monitoring interval, free trial, add-ons, cancellation and countries on 2026-10-03 and kept only claims they state; reported the vendor's own inconsistencies (7-day trial in help center and homepage FAQ vs '14-Day' on a homepage sign-up pop-up; '40,000+' vs '30,000+' users on the homepage; 50+/65+/70+ countries across pricing, features and help pages) as items to confirm, not resolved.

Writer (Sonnet): opened the Wikipedia, both arXiv abstracts and the Google Search Central AI features page with WebFetch on 2026-10-03 and kept only what each states (40% in the GEO abstract, up to 15% accuracy variation, AI Mode vs AI Overviews may use different models and techniques).

Writer (Sonnet): re-fetched otterly.ai/robots.txt and /llms.txt with a browser user agent on 2026-10-03 (both HTTP 200; robots.txt has 'User-agent: * / Allow: *' and no AI-bot blocks) to qualify the crawler study's 403 on a self-identifying crawler; stated as one fetch on one day, not a verdict on the product.

Writer (Sonnet): used first-hand AEOeye evidence only from the evidence pack: the otterly.ai row of the crawler access study (homepage and /llms.txt 403 to our crawler) with a link to /resources/ai-crawler-access-study-2026-10.json, and AEOeye product facts (free 3-question ChatGPT audit, $29 one-time report, not a daily tracker).
